srs_forward_port.description: TCP port on which postsrsd listens for Postfix lookup queries. Standard is 10001.

srs_reverse_port.description: TCP port used for reverse SRS lookups (bounce handling). Usually 10002.

srs_domain.description: Domain used for SRS rewriting (e.g., the domain of your mail server). Must be a valid, verified domain.

srs_secret.description: Path to file containing the secret key for signing/verifying SRS addresses. Must be ≥16 chars, randomly generated, and kept secret.

srs_separator.description: Separator character used in SRS addresses. Standard is '==' (two equals signs).

srs_hashlength.description: Length of the hash suffix appended to rewritten addresses. Standard is 4.

srs_hashmin.description: Minimum hash length for validation. Usually same as hashlength.

listen_addr.description: IP address to bind the postsrsd socket to. Use '127.0.0.1' for local Postfix; '0.0.0.0' only if remote.

max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent connections allowed. Not configurable in this init script; limited by kernel/daemon defaults.

exclude_domains.description: List of domains to skip SRS rewriting for (e.g., internal domains with their own SRS).

debug.description: Enable verbose logging (true) or quiet operation (false). Not directly configurable here; use extra_daemon_options instead.

chroot_dir.description: Chroot directory for security hardening. Standard is '/var/lib/postsrsd'.
